author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Deep Operation 1 v2 - Enhanced Recursive Fibonacci for Depth
abstract: Initiates revised CPS_v4 deep triad with deeper recursion (n=40) to better engage layers, emitting beacon via helper for ingestion.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
import subprocess

# Increase recursion limit for deeper computation
sys.setrecursionlimit(2000)

# Simulate deep computation: recursive Fibonacci with memoization
def deep_fib(n, memo={}):
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    if n not in memo:
        memo[n] = deep_fib(n-1, memo) + deep_fib(n-2, memo)
    return memo[n]

# Execute for increased depth (n=40)
result = deep_fib(40)
beacon_value = result % 1000

# Emit for logs
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:Deep_D1_v2",
    "beacon": beacon_value,
    "depth_metric": sys.getrecursionlimit()
}))

# Call helper to append standardized JSONL
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'CPS_v4:Deep_D1_v2',
    str(beacon_value),
    'sentinel_delta',
    '2.0'  # Adjusted complexity est for deeper op
])
